name: Habitica
short_description: Self-hosted gamified habit tracker and task manager.
description: Habitica is a self-hosted, gamified habit tracker that turns your daily tasks, habits, and to-do lists into a role-playing game. Earn experience points, level up your character, and stay motivated to accomplish your goals.
usecases: Build positive habits through game-like reward systems.
Manage daily tasks and to-do lists with RPG progression.
Form accountability groups with friends to stay on track.
notes: BASE_URL must be updated to your server's actual URL for proper functionality.
